messages:
ada: quick check — onboarding zeta-13b weights. HF path points to:

- hf://bigmodels/zeta13b/v1/weights
- s3://redwood-artifacts/incoming/zeta13b/2026-03-17/

Can infra confirm which is canonical for registry? I saw both referenced in the manifest.

sam: I think canonical should be the s3 path once mirror job finishes. HF origin is upstream. Did we get checksum from HF? :thinking_face: 

miguel: CI shows checksum mismatch on shard-0004.

ci-bot: artifact-check failed for zeta13b/shard-0004.bin — expected sha256 = `a3f2...d9`, got `a3f2...e0`.

tara: ugh. Could be transfer corruption or different manifest canonicalization. sam — can you re-run the mirror job or pull presigned URL? 

sam: re-running mirror now. command I used originally:
```
aws s3 cp s3://hf-mirror/zeta13b/shard-0004.bin s3://redwood-artifacts/incoming/zeta13b/shard-0004.bin --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```
I'll also compute sha256 locally: `sha256sum shard-0004.bin`

miguel: tokenizer note — when we tokenized eval set with `sentencepiece.model` we've seen an extra space token injected on some bilingual lines. Might affect cache key (prefix cache). Heads up for serving QA.

ada: Thanks — we'll add tokenization config to the artifact manifest: `tokenizer: sentencepiece; normalizer: nmt` so we can detect mismatches.

sam: mirror finished. New sha256 = `a3f2...d9` matches HF. CI re-run queued.

ci-bot: artifact-check passed for shard-0004.bin — all shards good. :tada:

tara: Access perms: infra said incoming bucket has object-level ACLs from HF. We need list/object read for `redwood-onboard` role. @infra-bot can you confirm IAM change applied?

infra-bot: IAM update applied. Role `redwood-onboard` granted `s3:GetObject` on `arn:aws:s3:::redwood-artifacts/incoming/zeta13b/*`.

ada: Sweet. Next: config validation flagged config.json having `max_seq_len` = 512 but weights were fine-tuned for 2048. We should update model config and bump rollout flag to `canary=true` during Dedicated tests.

miguel: I'll open the quick PR to update config + add eval set run. Ping @ada for review.

sam: quick FYI — if anyone needs presigned url to test locally: `https://redwood-artifacts.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/incoming/zeta13b/shard-0004.bin?X-Amz-Signature=...`

ada: perfect. closing loop once PR merged and CI green. Thanks all. :rocket:
